slices.focus: Caleb discovers smoked turkey as a reflux-safe cookout option and develops a practical framework for food choices with stress-triggered acid reflux
slices.summary: After a stressful day, Caleb chooses smoked turkey over spicier options at a high school baseball fundraiser and notices he sleeps much better. This leads to a broader realization about building a mental ranking of safe cookout choices, keeping sauce light, and recognizing that stress + hunger = bad decisions.
decisions: Caleb's reflux-driven food preference shifted more clearly toward milder cookout options after smoked turkey sat better
